name: DbGate
description: DbGate integrates electron-updater for startup checks, optional retrieval, and the install action, with GitHub publication configured for macOS, Linux, and Windows. Its checked macOS packaging configuration enables hardened runtime and notarization; the source reviewed here does not establish Windows signing status or independently prove SHA512 enforcement.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot at the recorded commit; electron-updater internals, generated manifests, and released artifact signing were not independently audited.
